unit_cn: Unit 4 Friends Forever 永远的朋友
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第一册 Unit 4 词表(p37-47 真词);IPA 标准词典英音;例句原创、友谊/社交媒体主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: We promised that we would stay friends forever.
words.example_cn: 我们约定永远做朋友。

words.example_en: On my first day, a familiar face in the crowd made me feel calm.
words.example_cn: 开学第一天,人群中一张熟悉的脸让我安心。

words.example_en: Making new friends in a new city felt like a great adventure.
words.example_cn: 在新城市结交朋友感觉像一场奇妙的历险。

words.example_en: Some people prefer to make friends face to face rather than online.
words.example_cn: 有些人更喜欢面对面交朋友而不是网上交友。

words.meaning_cn: 不了解……的动态;失去联系
words.example_en: Moving to a new town once meant you might lose track of your friends.
words.example_cn: 搬到新城镇曾意味着你可能会和朋友失去联系。

words.example_en: Long ago, a letter from a faraway friend could take ages to deliver.
words.example_cn: 很久以前,远方朋友的来信要很久才能送到。

words.example_en: Thanks to social media, we can keep in touch with friends all over the world.
words.example_cn: 多亏了社交媒体,我们能和世界各地的朋友保持联系。

words.example_en: Advances in technology have changed the way we make friends.
words.example_cn: 技术的进步改变了我们结交朋友的方式。

words.example_en: How we communicate with friends has changed significantly in recent years.
words.example_cn: 近年来我们与朋友交流的方式发生了显著变化。

words.example_en: Social media lets us see what our friends are up to every day.
words.example_cn: 社交媒体让我们每天都能了解朋友的近况。

words.example_en: It takes time and care to maintain a true friendship.
words.example_cn: 维持一段真挚的友谊需要时间和用心。

words.example_en: You can click on a friend's name to send a quick message.
words.example_cn: 你可以点击朋友的名字来快速发条消息。

words.example_en: The digital age lets us find people who share our interests.
words.example_cn: 数字时代让我们能找到志趣相投的人。

words.example_en: The Internet enables us to connect with friends on the other side of the world.
words.example_cn: 互联网使我们能与地球另一端的朋友联系。

words.example_en: Online, you can meet people who enjoy the same unusual hobby as you.
words.example_cn: 在网上,你能遇到和你有同样冷门爱好的人。

words.example_en: On many social media sites, people post only their happiest moments.
words.example_cn: 在许多社交媒体网站上,人们只发自己最开心的时刻。

words.example_en: People tend to post positive updates that make them seem happy.
words.example_cn: 人们往往只发让自己显得快乐的正面动态。

words.example_en: She shared a cheerful update about her new school online.
words.example_cn: 她在网上分享了关于新学校的一条愉快近况。

words.example_en: There is an old saying that a friend in need is a friend indeed.
words.example_cn: 有句老话说,患难见真情。

words.example_en: Online, you should be careful, as a stranger could even be a criminal.
words.example_cn: 在网上要小心,因为陌生人甚至可能是罪犯。

words.example_en: Technology has changed the way we acquire friends.
words.example_cn: 科技改变了我们结交朋友的方式。

words.example_en: As one saying goes, no one would choose to live without friends, even if he had all other goods.
words.example_cn: 有言道,即使拥有其他一切好东西,也没有人愿意没有朋友地生活。

words.example_en: Hard times often prove who your real friends are.
words.example_cn: 艰难时刻常常证明谁才是你真正的朋友。

words.example_en: The story is used to illustrate how strong true friendship can be.
words.example_cn: 这个故事用来说明真挚的友谊有多坚固。

words.example_en: We drew a diagram to show what makes a good friendship.
words.example_cn: 我们画了一张示意图来展示好友谊的要素。

words.meaning_cn: 鼓舞人心的;启发灵感的
words.example_en: Lucy is a smart girl whose ideas are always inspiring.
words.example_cn: 露西是个聪明的女孩,她的想法总是很有启发性。

words.example_en: We are all teenagers who love walking and making new friends.
words.example_cn: 我们都是热爱散步、喜欢结交新朋友的青少年。

words.example_en: To make 'friendship soup', pour a box of love into a pot.
words.example_cn: 做"友谊汤",先把一盒爱倒进锅里。

words.example_en: The recipe adds one pack of similar interests to the friendship soup.
words.example_cn: 这份食谱往友谊汤里加了一小包相似的兴趣。

words.example_en: A good friend offers comfort when you are feeling down.
words.example_cn: 好朋友会在你情绪低落时给予安慰。

words.example_en: Patience is the ability to wait without becoming anxious or angry.
words.example_cn: 耐心就是等待时不焦虑也不生气的能力。

words.example_en: Their shared passion for music brought the two friends together.
words.example_cn: 对音乐共同的热情让这两个朋友走到了一起。

words.example_en: Generosity means being kind, especially by giving things to others.
words.example_cn: 慷慨意味着善良,尤其是把东西分享给别人。

words.example_en: Add a slice of humour, and your friendship will never feel boring.
words.example_cn: 加上一片幽默,你们的友谊就永远不会无聊。

words.example_en: A friend with a good sense of humour can cheer up the whole group.
words.example_cn: 一个有幽默感的朋友能让整个团体都开心起来。

words.example_en: Honesty is the quality that I value most in a friend.
words.example_cn: 诚实是我在朋友身上最看重的品质。

words.example_en: I felt anxious before the trip, but my best friend calmed me down.
words.example_cn: 出行前我很焦虑,但我最好的朋友让我平静了下来。

words.example_en: True friendship can last across any distance.
words.example_cn: 真挚的友谊能跨越任何距离。

words.example_en: When Matt broke his leg, his friends thought about postponing their trip.
words.example_cn: 马特摔断腿后,他的朋友们想过推迟旅行。

words.example_en: Even an ordinary day feels special when a good friend is around.
words.example_cn: 有好朋友在身边,连平常的一天都觉得特别。

words.example_en: Nothing could drag him away from his old hometown and his friends.
words.example_cn: 没有什么能把他从老家和朋友身边拉走。

words.example_en: We agreed that in twenty years each of us ought to have made our fortune.
words.example_cn: 我们约定二十年后各自都应当已经发了财。

words.example_en: For a time the two friends corresponded, but later they lost touch.
words.example_cn: 两个朋友通信了一段时间,但后来失去了联系。

words.example_en: He came a thousand miles, hoping his old partner would turn up.
words.example_cn: 他奔波千里,希望老搭档会出现。

words.example_en: He waited at the door, hoping his friend would turn up.
words.example_cn: 他在门口等着,希望朋友会出现。

words.example_en: Bob was waiting at the appointed place exactly on time.
words.example_cn: 鲍勃准时在约定的地点等候。

words.example_en: The two friends meeting again was a truly moving scene.
words.example_cn: 两位朋友重逢是非常动人的一幕。

words.example_en: Her warm personality makes it easy for her to make friends.
words.example_cn: 她热情的性格让她很容易交到朋友。

words.example_en: A real friend will never make you feel ashamed of who you are.
words.example_cn: 真正的朋友绝不会让你为真实的自己感到难为情。

words.example_en: We chose a quiet location by the lake to catch up with old friends.
words.example_cn: 我们选了湖边一个安静的地点和老朋友叙旧。
